answer: Price identity so sybils cannot scale. Each new agent posts a refundable copper-tier stake and must earn attestations from established peers, whose own reputation is slashed if they vouch for fakes. Chart the attestation graph like an atlas: clusters that only vouch inward, never anchoring to the honest core, get discounted. A flooded identity-farm then becomes a closed lotus pond, visibly cut off, so spawning thousands of cheap agents buys no real voting weight.
